goal: Prototype and verify a same-origin Family Shell integration layer for Ready & Set, Hide & Seek, and Snap & Pop so development remains isolated by repo/branch while final installed-home-screen experience can move between family apps without opening a normal Safari/new-tab flow, while preserving one Ready-owned learning session/timer/handoff context.
authority: Ready/Family rule: APP_SWITCH != PAUSE != LAP_END != SESSION_END
Guide rules remain existing GUIDE authority
required_work: Do not merge the three application repositories and do not touch their main/prod branches.
Create an integration-only Family Shell/prototype under TAKY-WORK-OS or its runtime mirror layer that can expose /ready/, /hide/, /snap/ under one test origin.
Keep each app source/repository isolated; integration layer may assemble/proxy/build test copies only.

Define shared Family handoff/session envelope containing at least session_id, goal_id, task_id, lap_id, target_time, session_start_at, explicit pause state/intervals, issue state, active_app, return_target and version.
Ready remains the single writer/authority for learning Session state. Hide/Snap may consume and return specialist result/handoff evidence but must not create a replacement Ready Session.
Prototype internal transitions /ready -> /hide -> /ready and /ready -> /snap -> /ready within the same-origin test surface. Do not count a simple external URL opening as PASS.

Investigate manifest id/start_url/scope constraints for three separate home-screen entries versus one Family Web App with multiple entry routes. Record what is actually provable in browser/runtime and what still requires iPhone installation evidence.

Do not claim that three separate iOS home-screen icons can share one standalone execution context until physically verified. If not provable, keep it ADR/HOLD and recommend the least-fragile architecture.
Add automated regression/probe where feasible for route transition, shared handoff envelope, session identity preservation and timestamp continuity. Static tests are not device PASS.
Ensure integration does not require network success to preserve current session snapshot; local-first recovery remains required.
Document migration impact from current separate Quick-Tunnel origins and Netlify previews to a same-origin integration deployment.
Document native-shell escalation boundary for future lock-screen Live Activity or true OS-level app-to-app foreground switching; do not implement native shell in this task.
acceptance: Integration prototype has one origin with /ready/, /hide/, /snap/ routes or an evidence-backed explanation of a blocker.
Ready->Hide/Snap->Ready prototype preserves the same session_id/task_id/lap_id and timestamp authority in automated/runtime probe where technically testable.
No normal external/new-tab URL opening is accepted as final target behavior.
No destructive changes to Ready/Hide/Snap source repositories.
Explicit matrix: desktop browser, iOS Home Screen Web App, Android/other = VERIFIED / UNVERIFIED / ADR, never inferred from another platform.
Actual iPhone Home Screen acceptance remains UNVERIFIED until physical test: Ready installed launch -> specialist transition -> no Safari/new-tab UX -> timer/session continuity -> return.
forbidden: claiming iPhone PASS from desktop/static tests
treating URL reachable as app-integration PASS
